title: Deconstructing Off-Policy Ratios: Entropy-Normalized Trust Regions for Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2607.22186v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) accelerates large language model (LLM) post-training by overlapping rollout generation with policy optimization, but the resulting stale, off-policy data destabilizes optimization and can cause policy collapse. Existing methods gate tokens by ratio magnitude alone, applying one threshold at every position. We show that the ratio's natural scale is set by token entropy, so deviations from mid-trajectory weight updates stay within this scale and carry genuine exploration. We further identify an overlooked low-entropy regime that breaks this scaling, where a near-zero probability amplifies train--inference mismatch into noise far beyond what the local entropy admits. A magnitude threshold admits this noise and discards the exploration. We therefore propose the Entropy-Normalized Trust Region (ENTR). translated_title: 解构离策略比率：面向异步强化学习的熵归一化信任域
translated_abstract: 异步强化学习（RL）通过将回合生成与策略优化相互重叠，加速了大语言模型（LLM）的后训练，但由此产生的陈旧离策略数据会使优化过程不稳定，并可能导致策略崩溃。现有方法仅依据比率大小来筛选词元，在所有位置应用同一个阈值。我们证明，比率的自然尺度由词元熵决定，因此回合中段权重更新引起的偏差保持在这一尺度之内，并承载着真正的探索。我们进一步识别出一个被忽视的低熵状态，它会破坏这一尺度关系：接近于零的概率会将训练与推理之间的失配放大为远超局部熵所容许范围的噪声。基于大小的阈值会接纳这种噪声，却丢弃了探索信号。为此，我们提出熵归一化信任域（ENTR）。在长时程智能体任务和数学推理基准上，ENTR 优于现有方法。
tldr: 提出熵归一化信任域（ENTR），利用词元熵设定离策略比率的自然尺度以构建信任域，从而在异步强化学习的大语言模型后训练中稳定优化并保留真正的探索信号。
en_tdlr: Proposes Entropy-Normalized Trust Regions (ENTR), which set the natural scale of off-policy ratio thresholds by token entropy to stabilize asynchronous RL post-training of LLMs while preserving genuine exploration.
